scope: 作者批准的《寄生虫》司机短暂询问及相邻论断最小修订。仅 reviewed/parasite/zh 与 en 第01、02篇，共5处双语句群；第三篇、HTML、繁体映射和五语稿未改。

changes.zh_before: 一整部影片里，这一家人没有讨论过一次那两个人被赶走之后去了哪里。他们主动没有往下想。**那两个人的去处，被排除在他们那一格之外。**这不是不知道就可以免责，而是影片所拍的一种道德失明：眼前的题算完了，题外的人也就不再存在。
changes.zh_after: 这一家人不是从来没有想到过被赶走的人。基泽曾问起前任司机是否找到了新工作，父子用他年轻、一定能找到更好工作的推测安慰自己，基婷随后把话题拉回眼前的一家人。他们没有继续追问，也没有确认自己造成了什么损失。**那两个人的去处，短暂进入他们那一格，又被排除在外。**这不是想到一下就可以免责，而是影片所拍的一种道德失明：眼前的题算完了，题外的人也就不必再追问。
changes.en_before: Not once in the entire film does the family discuss where those two people go after being driven out. They actively refrain from thinking any further. **What becomes of those two people is excluded from their square.** Ignorance does not absolve them. This is a form of moral blindness the film puts before us: once the problem in front of them is solved, the people outside the problem cease to exist.
changes.en_after: The family does briefly think about the people it has driven out. Ki-taek once asks whether the former driver has found another job. Father and son reassure themselves with the supposition that he is young and will surely find something better, before Ki-jung brings the conversation back to their own family. They do not keep asking or establish what harm they have caused. **What becomes of those two people briefly enters their square, then is excluded again.** A passing thought does not absolve them. This is a form of moral blindness the film puts before us: once the immediate problem is solved, the people outside it no longer need to be asked about.

changes.zh_before: 基泽一家从头到尾没有讨论过一次：那个被赶走的司机后来去了哪里，被辞退的文光后来怎么样了。这两个名字在他们嘴里再也没有出现过。
changes.zh_after: 基泽曾问过被赶走的司机是否找到了新工作。基宇以他年轻、身体好、一定会有更好机会的推测作答，基婷随后打断，要求父亲先顾眼前的一家人。被赶走的那两个人后来如何生活，并没有因此成为他们真正要去查明的事。
changes.en_before: From beginning to end, the Kims never once discuss what happened to the driver they had dismissed, or how Moon-gwang fared after losing her job. Those two names never pass their lips again.
changes.en_after: Ki-taek once asks whether the dismissed driver has found another job. Ki-woo replies with the supposition that he is young and healthy and will surely have better opportunities. Ki-jung then interrupts, asking her father to worry about their own family first. What happens to the two displaced people does not thereby become something the Kims genuinely try to find out.

changes.zh_before: 这一点很容易被读成冷血。冷血是知道了以后不在乎，而这一家人根本没有走到知道那一步。
changes.zh_after: 所以不能简单说他们从未想到过。可一句短暂的关心也不使他们无辜。念头越过了边界，却很快被未经确认的自我安慰和自家人的急迫需要拉了回来。
changes.en_before: It is easy to read this as cold-bloodedness. But cold-bloodedness means knowing and not caring. This family never even reaches the point of knowing.
changes.en_after: So we cannot simply say they never thought about it. But a brief expression of concern does not make them innocent either. The thought crosses the boundary, only to be quickly drawn back by reassurance they have not verified and the urgent needs of their own family.

changes.zh_before: 从他们那一格里看，这道题是完整的：有四个位置，位置上原来有人，把人挪走，他们进去，题就算做完了。挪走的那些人去了哪里，不在这道题的题面上，所以也不必求解。
changes.zh_after: 从他们那一格里看，这道题是完整的：有四个位置，位置上原来有人，把人挪走，他们进去，题就算做完了。挪走的那些人去了哪里，虽然偶尔被问起，却不被算进必须求解的部分。
changes.en_before: From within their square, the problem is complete: there are four positions, other people occupy them, those people are moved aside, and the Kims move in. The problem is solved. Where the displaced people go is not part of the question, so it requires no answer.
changes.en_after: From within their square, the problem is complete: there are four positions, other people occupy them, those people are moved aside, and the Kims move in. The problem is solved. Where the displaced people go may occasionally be asked, but it is not counted among the things that must be resolved.

changes.zh_before: 两个格子在这一刻撞上了。**基泽一家在那一夜之前，并不知道自己上一个动作的另一头连着什么。**他们不是不想知道，是那一头从来没有出现在他们的画面里。
changes.zh_after: 两个格子在这一刻撞上了。**基泽一家在那一夜之前，并没有真正看见自己上一个动作的另一头连着什么。**他们曾短暂问起别人的去处，却没有把那一头完整纳入自己的画面。
changes.en_before: Two squares collide at this moment. **Before that night, the Kims did not know what lay at the other end of their previous action.** It was not that they did not want to know. That other end had never appeared in their picture.
changes.en_after: Two squares collide at this moment. **Before that night, the Kims had not truly seen what lay at the other end of their previous action.** They had briefly asked what became of others, but had never brought that other end fully into their picture.
